verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to disable LiteLLM's own product telemetry or usage tracking. The only related item (litellm-docs-12) describes keeping message content out of the user's own configured logging provider, and it states that spend metadata is still tracked. That is an adjacent logging control, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
